island_explorer.title: Island Explorer
island_explorer.description: Get to know the island and its inhabitants.

reward.message: You are now an official Island Explorer!

find_supplies.title: Find Supplies
find_supplies.description: Collect supply crates scattered around the island.

reward.message: Supplies secured. The island is a little safer.

village_visit.title: Village Visit
village_visit.description: Meet the village elder and learn about the island's history.

reward.message: You've learned about the village's history.

forest_run.title: Forest Run
forest_run.description: Visit the forest shopkeeper and get some supplies.

reward.message: You've seen the depths of the ocean.
